sdk_source_refs: TopoCheck replay of imported outputs and reduced failures
test_goal: Re-open a selected SGT output from import, recut, debug geometry, or reduced bug records and verify it remains loadable/checkable.
risk_summary: Failure handoff depends on durable SGT assets; replay must distinguish body outputs from standalone topology/debug assets and preserve source paths.

geometry.parameter_notes: For non-body topology assets, report topology type/count instead of body property expectations.

expected_behavior: The SGT should deserialize and TopoCheck cleanly, or produce a replayable failure with the source asset path preserved.
notes: Use flat_recipe and keep all referenced SGTs under artifacts unless a reviewed bug record promotes minimal fixtures.
